Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

7906816232761.sourceDescription:
Product Features
Classic christmas tree: Recreate a natural winter wonderland with this 7ft Christmas tree. Featuring 2719 PE and PVC tips and a 118 cm diameter, it delivers a beautifully balanced, lush and traditional profile in your holiday setting.
Automatic hinged setup: Featuring a sectioned trunk with pre-attached hinged tips that drop down automatically, this Christmas tree allows less time in shaping and more time enjoying the holidays (suggested shaping time: 30-50 minutes). The sectional build ensures compact off-season storage.
Flame-retardant tips: Flame-retardant PE and PVC tips help slow the spread of fire, offering added reassurance for seasonal decorating. Your family and pets can gather around this artificial Christmas tree and enjoy a warm, cosy holiday season.
Solid pine wood base: The stable pine wood base provides robust support for your Christmas tree while adding an elevated, textured aesthetic that complements natural holiday decor. The solid base assembles easily and stores compactly once festivities end.
Festive accent: This artificial Christmas tree serves as a versatile seasonal accent for your living room, office displays and holiday gatherings. It smoothly infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout.
 
Please Note
All dimensions are measured manually, so slight variations of 2–3 cm may occur.
Actual colours may vary slightly depending on monitor settings and screen displays.
Decorative items shown in the pictures are not included in the delivery.

With an impressive girth of 44cm and boasting 142 tips, this tree provides abundant space for your favourite decorations, from delicate baubles to shimmering tinsel. Its flexible, bendy branches let you express your creativity, shaping the tree to fit perfectly into your unique holiday display. The frosted finish evokes the enchanting look of a snowy morning, adding warmth and joy to your celebrations. Supported by sturdy plastic feet, this tree stands proudly on any surface, making it ideal for homes, offices, or even small apartments. Whether you’re decorating for Christmas, a winter party, or simply want to enjoy a touch of seasonal beauty, this tree encourages you to embrace the spirit of the season and create memories that will last a lifetime.

A mesh ribbon spirals down the tree like flowing water, adding softness and visual layering. A warm white string of lights is draped across the branches, casting a gentle glow without harsh glare. Once switched on, the lights resemble countless stars resting on the tree, bringing a warm, magical glow to the festive setting. Whether in a living room, hotel lobby or shop window, it adds a soft, romantic touch to any festive setting.

ART & CRAFTS GIFTS FOR 5 YEAR OLDS: These diy Christmas bauble kits make a great idea for stocking fillers & small gift ideas for both boys & girls alike; fun for the whole family to create together

Open the package and check all tools and drill gems.

Bring rose gold foliage into your seasonal decorating with this 1.8m artificial fern garland. Feathery fronds with narrow leaflets branch along the garland, creating an open foliage outline with a glittered surface. The glitter finish adds a decorative accent to Christmas displays, while the rose gold colour helps coordinate the arrangement with your chosen ribbons and ornaments. Lay a length along a mantel, arrange it around a banister or incorporate it into a festive window display. The artificial leaves can also form part of Christmas table centrepieces, wreath-making projects and indoor wedding decorations, allowing the same foliage style to appear in different areas. Plan each length around the space available and position your own accessories alongside it to complete the look. The rose gold colour can be used as the main accent or combined with other seasonal decorations, adding a leafy detail to indoor Christmas and party displays.
Mantel And Stair Decor: Arrange the 1.8m foliage length along a mantel, position it around a banister or use it within a Christmas window display. Plan the layout to suit your space, then add your own ribbons and ornaments to coordinate the garland with nearby festive decorations.
Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the rose gold fern foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.
Pack Size And Coverage: Contains 1 garland with a 1.8m decorative length. Use the single length for a focused display on a table, mantel or decorated tree. Coordinate with your own ribbons and ornaments to carry the foliage theme through your indoor seasonal arrangement.

3622392480061.sourceDescription:
High-Quality Metal Bells: Versatile Decor & Pet Accessories
Premium Material for Long-Lasting Use
Crafted from high-quality iron (with copper options for select styles), these bells feature environmentally friendly plating that resists fading—keeping their bright color intact for years. The thick material ensures they won’t easily deform, even with regular use, making them a durable choice for both decor and daily needs.
Crisp, Loud Sound for Easy Locating
A gentle shake is all it takes to make these bells produce a clear, pleasant sound—crisp and bright, with enough volume to help you easily find your pets. Whether your furry friend is wandering the yard or hiding indoors, the distinct ring lets you keep track of them without hassle, and the sound itself is enjoyable to hear.
Rust-Resistant Design for Durability
For copper styles, the bells are painted uniformly in an oven, creating a protective layer that prevents rust and erosion. This means they hold up well even in damp environments—perfect for outdoor use (like on cattle or sheep) or as long-term decor, without worrying about corrosion ruining their look or function.
Versatile Use for Holidays & Daily Life
These bells are incredibly multi-purpose: use them as Christmas tree decoration bells, prop bells for events, or handicraft ornament bells to add a festive touch. They also work great as pet anti-lost bells (for dogs, cats, or livestock like cattle and sheep), wind chime components, or even baby early childhood toys to stimulate hearing. No matter the use, they add charm and practicality to any scenario.
Premium Iron Construction for Long-Lasting Durability: Made of high-quality iron with eco-friendly plating, this bell resists fading to maintain its color over time. Its thick material prevents easy deformation, ensuring reliable, long-term use.
Super Loud, Pleasant Sound for Easy Locating: A gentle shake produces a clear, crisp, and bright sound—loud enough to help you quickly find your pet (or other animals) while remaining pleasant to the ear.
Rust-Proof Design with Copper & Oven-Painted Finish: Crafted with copper and coated in a uniform oven-painted layer, the bell is fully resistant to rust and erosion, keeping it in good condition even with regular exposure to the elements.
Versatile for Multiple Uses: Beyond pet/animal tracking (e.g., for cattle, sheep), it works perfectly as Christmas tree gift bells, prop decoration bells, handicraft ornaments, wind chime components, baby early-development bells, and bracelet bells.
Multi-Scenario Practicality: Whether for daily pet care, holiday decor (Christmas), DIY crafts, or baby sensory play, this bell combines functionality and aesthetics, making it a versatile addition to various settings.
Guarantee - 6 months

5096042277161.sourceDescription:
Green and red carry the whole colour scheme of this flexible PVC wreath. Ease the sections into position to suit a door or wall, leaving the two colours clear or picking one up in your own ribbons. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 50 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree.

If you plan to use the wreath in a group, set it out with your other decorations before you hang them. A little breathing room around its edge usually shows the shapes more clearly than placing several pieces edge to edge. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards.
Flexible PVC foliage allows you to shape the wreath sections easily to suit your door or wall display.
Indoor and outdoor durability ensures this festive decoration can be moved between hallway and entrance as needed.
Classic red and green colour scheme provides a traditional Christmas aesthetic for doors and walls.
Compact 50 cm diameter design fits standard doorways without overwhelming the space or blocking views.
Comes with None

5096042276461.variantName: Patchwork Christmas wreath kit - Fabric craft kit - Vintage fabric wreath design for a Christmas craft afternoon - 20 x 20 cm
5096042276461.sourceDescription:
Prepared pieces save cutting time on this small multicoloured wreath. The 20 x 20 cm project builds up into a thick textile decoration that can sit beside a mirror, above a coat rail or on a bedroom door.

Patchwork brings together the softness of the cloth and the definition of a picture. Each section contributes to a larger shape, so progress is visible as you go and the finished decoration retains the small variations of handwork. A plain surface gives individual colours room to show. For a coordinated arrangement elsewhere in the room, pick out just one of those colours for ribbon or a small group of ornaments.

Before putting the decoration away, let the textile layers settle into their natural positions. Support the shape from below when lifting it and allow enough space above the fabric to keep its raised appearance. The prepared shapes make it easier to compare adjoining pieces before fixing them. Lay out a small group at a time, keeping the rest together so that similarly coloured pieces remain easy to identify.

A wall beside a reading chair or a spot in the hall gives people a chance to see the handwork close up. Leave some space around the edge so that the pattern is easy to follow from the first detail to the last. Set out the pieces on a clear table where you can see the whole design. Group similar colours before you start and keep the next few pieces within reach, so you can follow the pattern without having to search through the materials.

Once complete, try the decoration against the surface where you intend to display it. A plain background outlines the finished shape, while a nearby side light picks out the surface detail when viewed from an angle. For a shared craft afternoon, one person can sort the next colours while another works on the current section.
Pre-cut fabric pieces save time and simplify the patchwork assembly process for a quick craft project.
Creates a thick, raised textile decoration with distinct vintage charm and handcrafted visual definition.
Compact 20 x 20 cm size fits perfectly on bedroom doors, mirrors or coat rails without overwhelming space.
Multicoloured patchwork design allows individual cloth sections to showcase soft textures against plain backgrounds.
Comes with Pre-cut fabric pieces for a 20 x 20 cm wreath.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Acrylic and Canvas. Product measurements: length 30 cm, width 30 cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to your holiday display.
Crafted from durable acrylic and canvas materials for long-lasting decorative appeal.
Compact 30cm x 30cm size fits perfectly on shelves, mantels or tables without cluttering space.
Versatile single set design allows easy coordination with existing Christmas colour schemes.
Guarantee - 1 month
Comes with 1 x Christmas decoration
Place on a flat surface away from visual clutter. Ensure the decoration has space around neighbouring pieces so its outline and detail remain visible.
